audit.whatIsWrong: Six full-layer rows read "Skill" while content win[] read Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Akali/Akali/Akali.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches win[] exactly; the lane is hers to level 5 and flips at 6, and the full layer said nothing at all.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side=Qiyana, [5..6].side=Akali; [4] already Akali. One atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly attributed a stun to Audacity ("terrain E stun", "E off any wall or bush stuns", "terrain-stun leash") and invented a mechanic called "Marked" applied by her Q.
audit.why: Audacity is a plain 650-range dash that damages — no stun. Her only stun is Supreme Display of Talent. Her passive is Royal Privilege (first attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage); nothing in the kit is named or functions as "Marked". The terrain dependency belongs to Terrashape (W), which enchants her weapon off nearby terrain on a 7s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Terrain rewritten as the Terrashape element pickup; the stun attributed to the ult; "Marked" removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Audacity is Qiyana's only gap-closer, and Terrashape needs terrain within reach to enchant her weapon.
audit.why: Deny either one and her all-in stops existing. Fighting in the open middle of the lane means an unenchanted Q, and a spent Audacity means she cannot reach you for the next 7-11 seconds. Her R also creates terrain and knocks up — it is the only hard CC that starts a fight for her, on a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: Fight away from walls, bait Audacity into the shroud, and hold your R until hers is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Audacity but gave no numbers and filled the rest with generic Akali advice.
audit.why: Audacity 11/10/9/8/7s, Terrashape 7s, Supreme Display of Talent a flat 120s — those three are the whole schedule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Qiyana referred to as "his" in tldr, dontsFull[2].t and report[9].t.
audit.corrected: Fixed where I edited; dontsFull[2].t and report[9].t left alone as they are outside the fields I could ground.

edits.after: Out-stall the dash duel and counter-kill her commitment. Shorthand: Audacity spent, no wall behind you, go.

edits.after: Qiyana wins by taking an element off the nearest wall, dashing in with Audacity, and stunning you with the R shockwave.

edits.before: - Qiyana Audacity: matchup-defining — Her stick dash — once spent she cannot reach you; kite the cooldown. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Twilight Shroud has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Audacity: 7-11s dash and her only way onto you; once it is spent she has no gap-closer at all. - Terrashape: 7s, and she must stand by terrain to enchant her weapon — fight her in open lane and the element never comes. - Supreme Display of Talent: 120s stun, 950 range.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Carry by fighting away from walls — with no element on her weapon Qiyana is a short-range dash with no stun.

edits.before: If Qiyana takes first blood, tighten up: Audacity is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Qiyana takes first blood, stop walking near walls — Terrashape needs terrain and the lane has plenty. A second kill means the duel is over and the game is not: farm at Q range, take only grouped picks.

edits.before: Her stick dash — once spent she cannot reach you; kite the cooldown. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Audacity is a 7-11s dash and her only entry — bait it into the shroud, then she cannot reach you for ten seconds.

edits.before: Qiyana whiffs Audacity and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Qiyana spends Audacity on the wave — go, she cannot reach you.

edits.before: Track Qiyana’s Audacity: Her stick dash — once spent she cannot reach you; kite the cooldown. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Audacity and the nearest wall: without an element from Terrashape her Q is plain damage, and without the dash she cannot reach you.

edits.before: Qiyana gets Grass-Elemental W stealth plus terrain E stun off any river bush or wall, and can all-in you the moment Q applies Marked before your Twilight Shroud timer is up.
edits.after: Qiyana enchants her weapon off any river bush or wall with Terrashape every 7s, then Audacity dashes in on top of you — she can open before your Twilight Shroud is back up.

edits.before: Both ults come online, but her Supreme Display of Talent stuns and resets on takedowns while your R needs a follow-up mark to seal the kill, so she still edges the burst race here.
edits.after: Both ults land at 6, but Supreme Display of Talent is a 950-range shockwave that stuns you straight out of your own combo — hold your R until hers is spent or you have dodged it.

edits.before: Qiyana's kit is built to punish exactly this lane: Q applies Marked, E off any wall or bush stuns, and W grants a movement-speed stealth dash that closes the gap before your Shroud timer even starts. From levels 3-5 she can all-in you off river terrain faster than you can threaten a full combo back, and her elemental empowerments (especially Water's slow) shut down your kite pattern. Play passive around walls, deny CS with Q poke instead of trading, and don't fight her within E range of any terrain feature until you have a level or item lead.
edits.after: Qiyana's kit is built to punish exactly this lane: Terrashape enchants her weapon off any wall or bush on a 7s cooldown, and Audacity dashes 650 units onto you the moment the element lands. From levels 3-5 she can all-in you off river terrain faster than you can threaten a full combo back, and her elemental empowerments (especially Water's slow) shut down your kite pattern. Play passive around walls, deny CS with Q poke instead of trading, and don't fight her within dash range of any terrain feature until you have a level or item lead.

edits.before: Level 6 is close but still hers — Supreme Display of Talent stuns on cast and resets on kills, letting her finish a combo your Perfect Execution mark can't always beat to. Keep your distance from terrain, force her to walk up without an elemental buff active, and use Shuriken Flip purely to reposition rather than initiate until you have vision denying her stealth angles. This is the phase to play for scaling, not for kills.
edits.after: Level 6 is close but still hers — Supreme Display of Talent detonates her element for a 950-range stun, letting her finish a combo your Perfect Execution can't always beat to. Keep your distance from terrain, force her to walk up without an elemental buff active, and use Shuriken Flip purely to reposition rather than initiate until you have vision denying her flank angles. This is the phase to play for scaling, not for kills.

edits.after: Qiyana's Terrashape element off any wall or bush plus the Audacity dash gives her the stronger early all-in before Shroud is up

edits.after: Freeze the wave near your tower before lvl 6 so she can't enchant off a wall and dash in

edits.after: Bait her Q poke into empty shrouds so she wastes the Audacity follow-up dash

notes: This matchup carried two invented mechanics: a stun on Audacity (it has none — the dash only damages) and a Q effect called "Marked" (her passive is Royal Privilege, bonus damage on the first hit against each enemy). Both were load-bearing across early, whys and spikes, so the terrain story is rewritten around Terrashape. Also dropped the unsupported claim that Supreme Display of Talent resets on takedowns. Unverified and therefore not written: whether Terrashape's Grass element grants camouflage (the page asserts "W stealth" in places I did not edit — Riot's text in the kit file mentions no stealth), and whether Twilight Shroud's reveal-stealth property would expose it.
